title: receiveTypingIndicators check is O(N) DB reads per fan-out in group chats
description: In Chat/typing server behavior (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md line 904) and ChatTypingEvent delivery (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md line 214), the spec requires checking each recipient's Chat.receiveTypingIndicators at delivery time. For a group chat or Space channel with N members, one incoming Chat/typing signal triggers N independent per-recipient Chat record lookups to check that preference before deciding whether to deliver. Typing events arrive continuously (rate-limited to 1/3s per sender, but multiple senders can fire simultaneously). The spec has no provision for caching or batching these lookups at the pub/sub layer. The common case (nearly all users have receiveTypingIndicators: true) pays the same cost as the rare opt-out case. A more efficient design would maintain an in-memory set of (chatId, ownerId) pairs where the preference is false, updated only on Chat/set mutations, so the fan-out path can skip the DB read entirely for the dominant case. The spec should at minimum acknowledge the per-recipient lookup cost and recommend against naïve per-event DB reads.
close_reason: Fixed in review fix wave or recorded as accepted design decision.
